en-US.name: Duo Sound: Fold Effects
en-US.subtitle: Custom Open & Close Audio
en-US.promotional_text: Give each fold a little personality. Choose original effects or import short clips. Requires a supported hinge and Duo Sound visible and active.
en-US.description:
Give opening and closing your iPhone Duo a sound of their own, while Duo Sound is visible and active.

CHOOSE BOTH SIDES
Pick a different effect for opening and closing, or switch either one off. Explore 20 original presets across Musical, Mechanical, Nature, Playful, and Sci-Fi categories. Try Crystal, Music Box, Zipper, Water Drop, Bubble, Laser, and more. Search the library and preview any effect without changing your saved selection.

MAKE IT YOURS
Import your own short, unprotected audio clips from Files. Clips must be playable by the app, no longer than 5 seconds, and no larger than 8 MiB (8,388,608 bytes). Adjust the effect volume to suit you.

KNOW WHEN IT WORKS
Physical fold detection requires a supported iPhone Duo, a compatible iOS version, and Duo Sound visible and active. It does not run as a system-wide sound service, listen while another app is open, or trigger while the phone is locked or the app is suspended. It does not change iOS lock sounds, notifications, ringtones, or call behavior.

TRY THE SOUNDS
Manual previews and the clearly labelled simulated-hinge controls let you explore the effects without claiming a physical fold occurred.

QUIET WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Effects respect Silent Mode and system volume. Playback follows your selected audio output, including headphones, and mixes with other audio.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics SDK, or microphone recording. Settings and copied imports are stored in the app's private storage. Device backups and any information you choose to send through external support services are governed by those services.

Use only audio you have permission to use. Duo Sound is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.
en-US.release_notes: Initial release with independent opening and closing effects, 20 original sound presets, a searchable library with independent previews, custom short-clip imports, volume controls, and clearly labelled manual previews. Physical fold effects operate only while the app is visible and active.
